listings.rawTitle: Salt Eau de Parfum Unisex 50 ml

listings.rawTitle: Saddle Eau de Parfum Unisex 50 ml

listings.rawTitle: Steam Eau de Parfum Unisex 50 ml
listings.description: Inspired by Lyn Harris’s lifelong love of tea, STEAM captures the serene beauty of an ancient tea plantation forest, where the damp air carries a sense of stillness and renewal. evaporate and the scent to linger in the air. Notes: Mandarin (Italy), Plum, Green Tea, Coriander, Black Pepper, Birch Tar, Cedar Wood Virginia, Juniper Wood France, Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Incense Incense sticks 30 piece
listings.description: A perfumer’s love of burning traditional incense. listings.rawTitle: Oud Maracuja Extrait Extrait de Parfum Unisex 100ml
listings.description: Oud Maracujá takes you to the heart of an oud wood forest and presents you with an exotic contrast between the thirst-quenching freshness of passion fruit and the tropical heat of oud wood. This unique accord is enhanced by the lushness of saffron, Indonesian patchouli and leather, then softened by benzoin from Laos and a duo of Turkish rose and vanilla absolutes. Relish in the unexpected with this fruity, woody extrait de parfum, which offers intense staying power and a long-lasting sillage!

listings.rawTitle: CASTLEY Eau de Parfum Unisex 125 ml
listings.description: Castley is inspired by the audacity and vision of 18th-century French explorers, who ventured into the unknown to discover new horizons. This fragrance embodies the same spirit of adventure and the modern man's thirst for exploration. With a transparent smoked bottle that symbolizes both urban sophistication and passion, Castley represents the bold, adventurous man ready to break boundaries and achieve new goals. Thanks to meticulously selected high-end ingredients, this Eau de Parfum expresses the perfect balance between luminous freshness and spicy energy, reflecting a vigorous man always on the move. Breezy citrus and mineral notes contrast with spicy Timut pepper, amber Labdanum, and noble Akigalawood, unveiling an intense side. A vibrant fragrance, embodying intrepidity and confidence with a unique history, shaping the trail of a bold ascent. “Thanks to bright citrus notes contrasted by the richness of spices and the nobility of woody-amber accords, this new composition offers a surprising impression of movement as well as balance.” – Julien Sprecher, Founder and Artistic Director of Parfums de Marly. Top notes: Bergamot, Fresh Ginger, Black PepperHeart notes: Petitgrain Citronnier, Timut Pepper, Neroli AccordBase notes: Akigalawood, Labdanum, Benzoin Accord

listings.rawTitle: L'eau des Sens Eau de Toilette Unisex 100 ml
listings.description: Attempting to capture all the facets of the bitter orange tree in a single fragrance is a bold endeavor. A unique creation in which all facets of the bitter orange tree are expressed: branches, leaves, blossoms, and fruit.Notes: orange blossom, angelica root, patchouli, and juniper berries.

listings.rawTitle: CARATE URIO Eau de Parfum Unisex 100 ml

In the heart: white flowers, iris, rosy lightness. The base: sandalwood, musk and cedarwood - soft, calm, deep. A fragrance for people who connect with the moment - intuitive, open, clear.

listings.rawTitle: DREAMER Eau de Parfum Unisex 100 ml

The heart brings herbs such as rosemary, sage, juniper berry and geranium, carried by ambroxan. The base is warm and grounding: musk, tonka bean, cedarwood, vetiver and olibanum. listings.rawTitle: Blue 1.1 Eau de Parfum Unisex 15 ml

Hypnotic lotus and dilated pupils, a moaning comes from my fingers of Geranium, a desire to taste you like a sip of orange juice. Green. I float on the wings of your cloud skin to you. listings.rawTitle: Blue 1.7 Eau de Parfum Unisex 115 ml
listings.description: This is a ray of sunshine, a radiant joy that enchants every moment. The warmth of Coconut Rose swirls between sandalwood and white musk. A vibrating ecstasy.

listings.rawTitle: Perfume Oil Painted Desert Perfume Oil & Rollerballs Unisex 10 ml
listings.description: Painted Desert is a fragrance born from a natural landscape that awes the senses in its scale and color. Notes of sage, frankincense, cedar, and sandalwood form an elemental base, layered with dewy brightness where the sun’s heat meets the cool ground’s breath. Desert heat and ancient stone. Earth and air in suspended dialogue. Softer to the skin than alcohol-based fragrances, Painted Desert perfume oil is packaged in a travel-friendly roll-on bottle that contains a highly concentrated form of the scent. The perfume is carried by an oil blend based on jojoba oil extract appropriate to pleasantly anoint the skin with. Encounter new facets of the fragrance revealed by the oil in touch with skin.

listings.rawTitle: Tales of Amber Parfum Perfume unisex 100 ml
listings.description: Tales of Amber draws on the mysterious allure of ambergris—one of perfumery's rarest treasures—and reinterprets it through a distinctly Australian perspective. This new extrait de parfum explores the interplay of time, landscape, and transformation, opening a bold new chapter in the brand's Botanical Series. Tales of Amber opens with the mineral freshness of moss and the floral clarity of orange blossom. The heart reveals powdery iris and sun-warmed cinnamon, gently enveloped in a veil of musk and resinous rockrose. The true depth of the fragrance unfolds in the drydown: an opulent blend of ambergris, Australian agarwood, and smoked vanilla, carried by a warm, leathery trail that lingers on the skin like sunlight on stone. Notes: New Zealand Ambergris, De Laire Amber 83 (Labdanum & Vanillin), Australian Agarwood, Orange Blossom, Iris, Cinnamon, Oud

listings.rawTitle: Petit Sauvage Perfume Oil Perfume Oil & Rollerballs Unisex 10 ml
listings.description: A fragrance shaped by raw landscapes and ­crafted from untamed ­elements and wild ­botanicals. It opens with a sting—handpicked pink ­pepper, wild juniper from high-­altitude forests, wild lime, and warm saffron, dry as desert air. At its ­heart, a surprise: Golden pineapple ripened under open skies, lush wild fig, and green notes of citrusy elderflower growing along forgotten paths, ­kissed by sea salt on a restless wind. The base is ­instinctive—salt-­bleached driftwood, dry cedarwood from ancient groves, and a clean musk that feels both feral and restrained. Petit Sauvage, “Little Wild One,” is more than a ­fragrance. It’s a ­memory. A feeling. Sun-warmed skin, wind-burnt and free. A little wild. Always free. Notes: Pink pepper, wild ­elderflower, wild pineapple, wild lime, saffron, wild fig, ­driftwood, sea salt.

listings.rawTitle: Crystal Saffron Extrait Extrait de Parfum Unisex 100ml
listings.description: Crystal Saffron is a sharp and bright fragrance that highlights the beauty of its main natural ingredient, Saffron Oil Greece, considered to be the most qualitative saffron in the world. To create Crystal Saffron Extrait, Aurélien Guichard has selected Myrrh Oil Somalia as a guest ingredient, and combined it with a higher perfume concentration and an even higher dosage of saffron. “A luminous, almost crystalline saffron.” – Aurélien Guichard, Perfumer & Founder

listings.rawTitle: Falcon Leather Extrait Extrait de Parfum Unisex 100ml
listings.description: Falcon Leather is a powerfully textured and intense fragrance built around a unique vegetal leather note: Birch Tar Finland. listings.rawTitle: Radical Rose Extrait Extrait de Parfum Unisex 100ml
listings.description: Radical Rose surprises as a genderless rose fragrance, strong and radiant, with the highest possible dosage of Rose Centifolia Absolute France, organically grown by MATIERE PREMIERE in the Grasse region. listings.rawTitle: Encens Suave Extrait Extrait de Parfum Unisex 50ml

listings.rawTitle: Vanilla Haze Extrait Extrait de Parfum Unisex 100 ml
listings.description: It's the after-hours version of Vanilla Haze EDP, created for moments that don't follow the rules. This fragrance begins with creamy coconut milk and roasted hazelnut—and then: a hint of lemon. Soft vanilla, smoky tonka, a hint of clove, and the warm, skin-tight appeal of cashmeran emerge after the opening. The base leaves an impressive trail of saffron, caramel, musk, and a hint of bourbon vanilla that lingers. Vanilla Haze XDP isn't for everyone. It's for those who plunge into the night and enjoy a little danger and play with elegance. “I didn't want to create a fragrance that was simple and safe. Vanilla Haze XDP is a fragrance that's different. Deeper, darker, bolder." - Bram Niessink, founder Top notes: Lemon, Hazelnut, Coconut MilkHeart notes: Vanilla Co2, Madagascan Orpur, Tonka Bean, Clove, CashmeranBase notes: Saffron, Akigawood, Musk, Caramel, Vanilla Gousse Bourbon Delight

The soft, poetic scent of a rose is reimagined in a sultry mix of peach and neroli, whilst musk and cardamom introduce a provocatively spiced edge. These heady depths are lifted by the brightening pairing of sandalwood and birch. Notes: Bergamot Calabria, Mandarin Italy, Peach, Neroli Tunisia, Rose Isolates, Cardamom India, Sandalwood, Papyrus, Birch, Musk​.

listings.rawTitle: THE MUSC Eau de Parfum Unisex 10 ml
listings.description: At once fresh, honeyed, and warm, The Musc is a subtle blend of captivating scents. It opens with red ginger from Laos and natural lavandin grosso from France. Australia’s natural sandalwood punctuates the blend with warm, woody tones. A blend of natural Cinnamon bark and sensual leathery tones of natural Osmanthus reveal rich facets of blond Tobacco and dried fruits. The warm, gourmand heart offers an addictive dose of cocoa, balanced with the deep, woody notes of clearwood® and tea. Finally, the woody, warm and earthy base reveals a mysterious patchouli in harmony with the sensuality and roundness of vetiver and cetalox®, for a deep and bewitching trail. "I imagined a sensual patchouli, at once addictive, deep and mysterious. The composition finds a balance between the richness of patchouli and the powdery sweetness of cocoa." - Fabrice Pellegrin, perfumer

listings.rawTitle: NEROLI BOTANICA Eau de Parfum Unisex 10 ml
listings.description: The orange blossom, that white bud with a thousand subtle nuances, is at the heart of the creation and inspiration of master-perfumer Anne Flipo. Spicy and vibrant at opening, the fragrance burst with notes of curcuma leaf & ginger studded with a duo of pink and black peppers. Gloriously enhanced with neroli and Sambac jasmine, the orange blossom unleashes all its floral strength. Its solar and voluptuous facets blends with the green & velvety woody base notes of vetiver & sandalwood, both labelled with the sustainable label “For Life”. "I imagined an androgynous orange blossom that you want to smell again and again... Facetted with fusing spices and a bewitching heart of jasmine and neroli, its powerful trail melts into a hypnotic woody base of sandalwood and vetiver." - Anne Flipo, perfumer

listings.rawTitle: VELVET IRIS Eau de Parfum Unisex 10 ml
listings.description: Ode to the velvety petals of the flower, Dominique Ropion delivers a woody, carnal interpretation of the iris. It all begins with a breath of spicy freshness, rising like the majestic stem of the iris: pink pepper and turmeric leaf electrify buchu leaf with aromatic and herbaceous accents. Balanced by the crisp greenness of galbanum and lentisque, the precious iris concrete gradually warms on the skin, revealing more carnal inflections, both creamy and powdery. Sensuality blooms ever so softly, brought to life by the drydown of Velvet Iris: a woven from the milky notes of sandalwood, the warmth of labdanum and the contemporary vibrations of Saffiano™, an exclusive IFF molecule that combines the power of leather with the softness of suede. A truly languorous experience, Velvet Iris reveals its powerful yet caressingly soft signature when worn. A hypnotic trail, elegant and infinitely carnal. "I imagined a woody iris as an ode to the flower’s velvety petals. Pulsing with the suave radiance of pink pepper and buchu, it unfolds its green facets, infused with galbanum. Ambered and creamy woods embrace it in an infinitely carnal skin-to-skin caress." - Dominique Ropion, perfumer

listings.rawTitle: Icons Collection 2 Eau de Parfum Unisex 45 ml
listings.description: Drawn from Lyn’s favourite woods and ferns, Steam, Moss, Dandelion, Ink and Rain Wood come together as a set of to capture the shifting tones of the wild. Perfect for discovering the world of Perfumer H or gifting someone special with a journey through scent. The set contains 5 x 8ml Eau de Parfum Sprays:Ink Moss DandelionRain Wood Steam

listings.rawTitle: ATHÉNAÏS Eau de Parfum Unisex 75 ml
listings.description: A Floral Ambery fragrance opening with vibrant and sparkling notes of neroli and yuzu bringing an immediate sense of uplifting dynamism. The heart unfolds with the elegance and generosity of orange flower and jasmine. Followed by a base that deepens with a modern duo of tonka beans and vanilla bringing a powdery and addicting facet to the fragrance and further balanced with the comforting note of amber - adding warmth and depth. Each note works in harmony to capture the multifaceted nature of Athenais, from bright, passionate energy to a gentle and enduring grace. Top notes: Neroli, Bergamot, YuzuHeart notes: Orange Blossom, JasmineBase notes: Tonka Bean, Vanilla, Ambrox

listings.rawTitle: Gris Charnel Shower Gel 300 ml
listings.description: Born from David Benedek’s vision of bringing emotions to life through scent, the new “Le Soin Parfumé” collection—comprising shower gel and body lotion—extends the olfactory signature of the fragrances and enhances the ritual. Woody and powdery, Gris Charnel Body Wash turns shower time into a moment of pure intimacy. Its creamy lather cleanses and wraps the skin in sandalwood, fig, and black tea notes.

listings.rawTitle: Pas Ce Soir Shower Gel 300 ml
listings.description: Born from David Benedek’s vision of bringing emotions to life through scent, the new “Le Soin Parfumé” collection—comprising shower gel and body lotion—extends the olfactory signature of the fragrances and enhances the ritual. Fruity and floral, Pas ce Soir evokes a Parisian evening full of mystery and boldness. Its gentle foam cleanses and hydrates the skin, leaving a subtle trail of jasmine, quince, and orange blossom.

listings.rawTitle: Rouge Smoking Shower Gel 300 ml
listings.description: Born from David Benedek’s vision of bringing emotions to life through scent, the new “Le Soin Parfumé” collection—comprising shower gel and body lotion—extends the olfactory signature of the fragrances and enhances the ritual. Fruity and ambery, the Body Wash Rouge Smoking captures the vibrant spirit of Pigalle. Its airy foam gently cleanses the skin while leaving it scented with cherry, black vanilla, and tonka bean.

listings.rawTitle: Shady Garden Eau de Parfum Eau de Parfum Unisex 50 ml
listings.description: A fragrance for anyone drawn to the allure of the hidden. Shady Garden unfolds a mysterious composition of dew-fresh blossoms, smoky incense, and earthy depth. The top note opens with floral freshness and a fruity nuance, while the heart combines violet, raspberry, and incense. In the base, rose, ambroxan, and patchouli blend into a warm, sensual signature. A multi-layered fragrance composition that oscillates between lightness and depth, transparency and mystery. Top notes: Peony, Arctic blackberry.Heart notes: Violet, raspberry, incense.Base notes: Rose, ambroxan, patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Mareld Perfume Oil Perfume Oil & Rollerballs Unisex 10 ml
listings.description: Inspired by a rare marine phenomenon in which bioluminescent organisms make the water glow, Mareld unfolds a fascinating, aquatic fragrance world. The composition opens with salty and fresh notes, evolving through floral nuances to a warm, slightly woody base. Marine accords lend the fragrance a special depth and luminosity. The alcohol-free perfume oil is based on natural oils and is ideal for on-the-go use or for refreshing your scent throughout the day. Top notes: Salty fig, bergamot, eucalyptus.Heart notes: Violet, mimosa, marine notes.Base notes: Tonka bean, clary sage, seaweed.

listings.rawTitle: September Perfume Oil Perfume Oil & Rollerballs Unisex 10 ml
listings.description: September captures the atmosphere of an early autumn day—warm light, fresh harvest, and a sense of new beginnings. The composition blends citrus freshness with aromatic and woody nuances. Fruity top notes transition into a floral heart, while smoky and warm base notes add depth. The result is a balanced fragrance that blends freshness and warmth. This alcohol-free perfume oil is ideal for on-the-go use and allows you to refresh your scent as needed. Top notes: Pomelo, kumquat, lavender.Heart notes: Eucalyptus, apple blossom, jasmine.Base notes: Vetiver smoke, papyrus, guaiac wood, pink praline.

listings.rawTitle: Violet Sky Perfume Oil Perfume Oil & Rollerballs Unisex 10 ml
listings.description: Violet Sky is a tribute to the magic of a Scandinavian summer evening. A pink light spreads across the horizon, creating a special, almost surreal atmosphere. The composition blends dark, fruity notes with warm, resinous, and woody accords. The result is a sensual fragrance with depth and character. The alcohol-free perfume oil is easy to apply and is ideal for on-the-go use or for reapplying the fragrance. Top note: Tobacco leavesHeart notes: Plum, labdanum, blackberryBase notes: Tonka bean, cedarwood

listings.rawTitle: Chantilly Extrait Extrait de Parfum Unisex 100 ml
listings.description: Chantilly: a jewel of the lacemaking art, appreciated for its refined, light, and playful character. Easily recognized by its floral and fruity garlands, it is a smooth lace, originating in the same French city as the delicious Chantilly cream. In the eponymous fragrance, Luca Gritti combines the freshness of summer fruits with the nuances of vanilla. The juiciness of strawberry and the delicacy of blackcurrant blossom give it a liveliness and carefree spirit. Today, Chantilly is also available in the Extrait version: a more concentrated interpretation that magnifies its gourmand charm and prolongs its radiant trail, offering an even more enveloping and sensual experience. Top notes: Melon, Strawberry, Bergamot Heart notes: Apple, Coconut, Blackcurrant flower Base notes: Vanilla, Powder, Musk

listings.rawTitle: COLOGNE 01 Eau de Cologne Unisex 100 ml
listings.description: Cologne One captures the freshness of a gin and tonic in a single, sparkling gesture: effervescent, bright, unmistakably clean. The fragrance lives in its top notes: juniper for the gin, lime and citrus for lift, a touch of bergamot and mandarin, a whisper of ginger for a delicate spiciness, and a hint of cucumber’s neutrality to enhance the crispness without becoming literal. It is freshness concentrated, transparent, and immediate. The heart remains understated: iris, rose, and hadione offer just enough structure to support the top note, allowing the bright citrus and juniper to linger. The dry down is linear, calm, and unobtrusive: Ambroxan, Iso E Super, and a trace of musk. Nothing competes, nothing distracts. “We have a very different approach to fragrance, so our first cologne captures the very unique and wonderful freshness of a gin and tonic. I think it's quite new with that sort of freshness. It's the idea of the sparkling, effervescent gin and tonic first scent, this sort of your nose in the drink.” – Geza Schoen, perfumer. Top notes: Juniperberry, Lemon, Lime, Mandarin, Bergamot, Ginger, Cucumber Heart notes: Hedione, Rose, Iris, Waterlily Base notes: Iso E Super, Ambroxan, Musk

listings.rawTitle: Eau des Sens Hair Perfume Unisex 30 ml
listings.description: A mist that imbues the hair with the iconic Eau des Sens, in summer's limited-edition design. Bitter orange in all its splendor.A light and delicate veil reveals the vibrant, zesty notes of summer. The bottle features an exquisite design, created by Mathilde Jonquière, representing the sunlit fragments of a mosaic to convey the freshness of orange blossoms.Notes: orange blossom, angelica root, patchouli, and juniper berries.

listings.rawTitle: Bergamot Hand Wash Hand soap & scrub 500 ml
listings.description: A mild hand wash made with 85% naturally derived ingredients, including moisturising glycerin and calming marigold extract — created to bring the effortless beauty of nature into everyday care. Designed as an extension of Lyn Harris personal affinity for citrus, the new Bergamot Bathing Line captures the natural freshness and versatility of its namesake. Functional yet sensorial, the Bergamot Bathing Line is intended for simple, uplifting daily rituals — bringing a sense of joy and quiet anticipation for the day ahead. In Bergamot, this classic citrus is fused with clean aldehydes, petitgrain and Scillian lemon, and deepened by the glow of clove, frankincense and juniper wood. Finished by a smudge of tonka and a sprinkling of fresh lavender. This balance of warmth and clarity is pure summer; floating in a sea heavy with salt, eyes closed against the hot sun.

listings.rawTitle: Bergamot Shower Wash Shower Gel 500 ml
listings.description: A gentle shower wash that cleanses without stripping, helping to maintain the skin’s natural balance. Formulated with plant-derived cleansing agents and soothing calendula extract, Perfumer H Shower Wash brings the effortless beauty of nature into everyday care. Designed as an extension of Lyn Harris personal affinity for citrus, the new Bergamot Bathing Line captures the natural freshness and versatility of its namesake. In Bergamot, this classic citrus is fused with clean aldehydes, petitgrain and Scillian lemon, and deepened by the glow of clove, frankincense and juniper wood. Finished by a smudge of tonka and a sprinkling of fresh lavender. This balance of warmth and clarity is pure summer; floating in a sea heavy with salt, eyes closed against the hot sun.

listings.rawTitle: Perfume Mist de Guava Fragrance Bodyspray 50 ml
listings.description: By popular demand, this juicy fragrance hydrates, protects against pollution, and adds a sun-kissed shimmer—the perfect finishing touch to any hair routine! Transport yourself to la Isla wherever you go with this long-lasting, tropically scented hair and body mist.

listings.rawTitle: Spray No.2 Le Volume Hair Spray 150 ml
listings.description: For visibly thicker and vitalised hair with an airy feel) Its fluid and light formula provides volume and suppleness without making hair sticky. Hair feels revitalised, gets a bouncy finish and a silky shine. An ideal daily treatment for fine and limp hair or to enhance volume and provide a glamour effect to any type or style of hair.

listings.rawTitle: Brow Tamer Eyebrow Gel 4.50 ml
listings.description: This long-wearing brow beautifier is the perfect finishing touch to any brow look, defining and shaping instantly. The soothing formula with aloe vera and panthenol conditions brow hairs and gives a natural, soft effect.

listings.rawTitle: Intensive Treatment Foot Oil Foot Care 100 ml
listings.description: A unique, non-greasy, easy-to-apply dry oil that instantly transforms dehydrated skin and nails, leaving the feet illuminated, hydrated and smooth. Simple to use with a spray applicator and the beautiful scent of Lemon Myrtle, this light but powerful oil is a very quick fix, and works instantly to eradicate the signs of dehydration and repairs cracked skin of the feet. It is simply a joy to use. Suitable for all skin types, diabetics, and for use during pregnancy.

listings.rawTitle: Restoration Oil Face Oil 30 ml
listings.description: A beautiful blend of cellular nutrients, floral oils & extracts to help restore the skin’s youthful vitality, plump, calm and firm. High tech natural actives help boost collagen production, calm, hydrate and replenish, improving elasticity and reducing the appearance of fine lines for a healthy, radiant complexion. Ideal for all skin types. Exceptionally light oil. Wonderful at night or am during the colder months.

listings.rawTitle: Rose de Mai Face Oil 30 ml
listings.description: Chantecaille introduces Rose de Mai Face Oil, the latest addition to the Rose de Mai collection. Brightening and Anti-Aging, the supercharged formula pairs a luxurious, nourishing texture with the healing properties of Chantecaille’s iconic Rose de Mai.Known for its unique array of benefits, Rose de Mai is rich in Vitamin C and powerful Anti-Aging and healing properties. Boosted by a rich bouquet of roses: RoseHip, Evening Primrose, Rose Damascena and Rose Geranium, the 100% natural elixir regenerates, nourishes and restructures skin.- Ultra nourishing plant oils harvested from four corners of the world, combined with a high concentration of pure and active plant ingredients work immediately to create supple, dewy skin- Over time the formula strengthens and tightens collagen to visibly smooth the skin and boosts skin’s metabolism to lessen the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles and increase firmness- Delivers immediate hydration in just a few drops- The lightweight yet rich oil helps rejuvenate and clarify skin, creating a healthy sheer glow.

listings.rawTitle: Slant Tweezer Pretty In Pink Tweezers 1 piece
listings.description: A ‘Best of Beauty’ winner chosen by Allure editors for 9 years. Positively the finest general use tweezer in the world - top eyebrow artists always recommend our original, award winning Slant for expert brow shaping. The perfectly aligned, hand-filed tips are slanted to grab every hair, every time with the smoothest, true precision. In classic stainless steel or stainless steel with enamel color finishes.

listings.rawTitle: Voluminous Spray Hair Spray 177 ml
listings.description: Serves as a versatile natural volumizer that revitalizes the scalp while keeping hair in place. Provides a soft, flexible hold, keeps hair fresh and full of life. Experience aromatheraputic lavender and eucalyptus essence that calms and relaxes the senses during application and wear. High - performance organic citrus juices provide staying power and work to revive and rejuvenate the hair. Non-sticky texture has shape memory, especially for the next day, mess it up then return to shape and voila nature at it’s best. Apply allover, let set enjoy.

listings.rawTitle: Cell Revitalise Night Moisturiser Night Cream 60 ml
listings.description: Supercharged, targeted botanicals include Baobab, which is rich in precious Omegas to revitalise the skin, firming Kigelia Africana, Rosehip and antioxidant-rich Hibiscus to fight oxidative stress. Borage, Mongongo and Avocado oils offer abundant levels of natural fatty acids offering long-lasting hydration and a youthful glow. Deeply nourishing Shea butter and cooling Aloe vera enable this night cream to melt delightfully into the skin. A delicate, relaxing sleep-time essential oil blend of Neroli, Lavender, Rose and Mandarin helps you wind down and prepare for a restful night’s sleep.

listings.rawTitle: LED 15X Magnifying Mirror Cosmetic mirror 1 piece
listings.description: This innovative magnifying mirror is illuminated all around. Optically correct, it offers a clear view of the finest hairs without distortion. The ideal magnifying mirror without for plucking eyebrows, applying make-up or inserting contact lenses. With its suction cups, it can be attached to any smooth, clean surface. Simply indispensable for at home or when travelling.

listings.rawTitle: Omoressence Boosters & essences 100 ml
listings.description: Applied immediately after cleansing, this balancing and hydrating essence prepares the skin for further treatment by helping it to attract and retain moisture. It restores skin’s physiological balance and guards against environmental stress throughout the day.

listings.rawTitle: Bain Volumateur aux Algues Shampoo 200 ml
listings.description: Long hair is by its nature older, which means the ends can often be dry, brittle and susceptible to breakage. Leonor Greyl’s Bain Volmateur aux Algues nourishes long, delicate strands without smothering, and so fine hair is hydrated without looking flat. Multi-award winning, Leonor Greyl’s products are truly revolutionary; created with great care using only all-natural plant extracts, vitamins and other beneficial ingredients and no Sodium Lauryl Sulphate, silicones, parabens, coal tar or harsh, potential harmful chemicals.

listings.rawTitle: Luminizer Highlighter 5 g
listings.description: Nothing compares in magically highlighting the skin. This formula is the ultimate illuminator for creating a sensuous, sheer, luminous glow. Best of all, the living luminizer enhances the skin's natural youthfulness without being sticky, greasy or glittery.

listings.rawTitle: Revitalizing Body Oil 125 ml
listings.description: This luxurious, fast-absorbing body oil provides comprehensive antiaging, hydrating and restorative benefits to the entire body. Its concentrated formula revitalizes and invigorates the skin by infusing it with essential vitamins, minerals and nutrients for an immediately improved, radiant appearance. Helps promote healthy microcirculation, improve oxygenation, and reduce inflammation while deeply moisturizing and relieving dry, rough patches. Skin is left feeling soft, silky and rejuvenated.

listings.rawTitle: Miracle Facial Oil Face Oil 30 ml
listings.description: Suitable for use morning and evening, this facial oil replenishes like a rich cream yet it absorbs instantly like a serum. Naturally scented with mimosa, it contains a blend of precious extracts that hydrate, reduce fine lines and wrinkles and guard against environmental stress.

listings.rawTitle: Ocean Mist Hair Spray 150 ml
listings.description: Sachajuan Ocean Mist leave in formula delivers a beach feel. The hair gets a natural twist and volume like after a day at the beach with sun and great waves.

listings.rawTitle: Lapis Facial Oil Face Oil 50 ml
listings.description: Lapis Lazuli, a favorite stone of ancient Eygpt, is known for its gorgeous deep blue color. Lapis Facial Oil is named for the precious blue oils it contains, including Blue Tansy and Blue Yarrow. These oils contain a component called Azulene which acts as a powerful anti inflammatory and anti bacterial that aids in reducing redness and clarifying the complexion. Formulated for combination, oily and blemish prone skin types or any skin in need of relief from inflammation.

listings.rawTitle: Coco Rose Body Polish Body Peeling 226 g
listings.description: Coco Rose Body Polish is a highly moisturizing and gently exfoliating blend of virgin coconut oil and delicately floral Moroccan Rose. Leaves your skin soft and hydrated with a light scent of coconut and rose petals.

listings.rawTitle: Australian Salt Spray Hair Spray 150 ml
listings.description: At 14 Rue Notre-Dame des Victoires, up a winding staircase in the heart of Paris, you will find an ostrich. The antique taxidermy that presides over David Mallett’s Salon is a nod to his Australian roots. Once again, this latest facet of his eclectic lifestyle reflects a dash of down under. Previously, Murray River salt was generally only known amongst the globe’s three-Michelin-starred chefs. Now, however, David Mallett harnesses it to create his new Australian Salt Spray.The gourmet salt is harvested from naturally occurring brine in the Murray-Darling Basin in New South Wales. Concentrated brine is pumped from the underground aquifers and left to crystallize in the sun. The result is a salt rich in magnesium and calcium – natural minerals that are especially beneficial for the hair. With its unmistakable pink colour and unrivalled mildness, it is the main ingredient in the new Australian Salt Spray by David Mallett.As if dried in the wind after bathing in the sea, Australian Salt Spray lends the hair a striking appearance with extra volume. With its subtle fragrance of yuzu and bergamot, it creates fresh vitality and rich texture.

listings.rawTitle: HOLT Eyeliner 1 g
listings.description: Whether you are after the ultimate cat eye or like things smudged and smoky, this wax-based eyeliner lays down insanely rich, saturated color with total precision.

listings.rawTitle: Blooming Lilac Mini Slant Tweezer Tweezers 1 piece
listings.description: The Mini Slant Tweezer is the compact version of Tweezerman’s award-winning Slant Tweezer. Featuring perfectly aligned, hand-filed tips, it removes unwanted hair with exceptional precision and ease.

listings.rawTitle: Monday to Sunday Bamboo Muslins Cleansing Wipes 1 piece
listings.description: To achieve ultimate daily results we believe that you need to remove your cleanser with more than just warm water. Using one of our antibacterial bamboo muslins enables you to gently lift away daily grime and make up whilst stimulating circulation. This in turn speeds the skin’s natural renewal process, resulting in a brighter complexion, leaving fresher, younger skin cells sitting on your skin's surface enabling product to absorb quickly and work more effectively.Why Bamboo?Aurelia has designed unique bamboo muslins which have a number of added benefits over usual muslins:• Made with natural bamboo fibres offering superior antibacterial properties• Finely woven so they are very soft and not so rough on sensitive skins• Organic• You can also pop them in the washing machine and they will not become scratchy or stiff!

listings.rawTitle: Pure Silk Pillowcase Silk cushion covers 1 piece
listings.description: Holistic Silk Rejuvenating Anti Ageing Silk Pillowcase is a naturally dyed and hypoallergenic pillowcase which helps protect the skin from developing fine lines and wrinkles.Beautifully smooth and luxurious, this 100% Silk pillowcase doesn’t soak up moisture or oil and so allows your night creams to work to their full potential. The softness of this fabric prevents hair from snagging and splitting to prevent split ends and also works to prolong your blow dry.

listings.rawTitle: Huile de Leonor Greyl Hair Oil 95 ml
listings.description: It was a trip to the Antilles that marks the beginnings of Huile de Leonor Greyl. Stuck by a hurricane, Mr. Greyl observed the palm trees and noticed that the water slid along its leaves without ever getting them wet. The incredible properties of this plant inspired him to introduce this oil into a treatment that would protect the hair from aggressions by forming a barrier that resists water. Used both at the beach between bathing, to protect before coloring, or to repair hair, this oil quickly became a cult product with the general public.

listings.rawTitle: Hydrating Milky Mist Face Spray 80 ml
listings.description: This feather light mist provides an instant surge of hydration with hyaluronic acid to plump skin. A blend of black oat, provitamin A, and linoleic acid makes this rejuvenator the perfect first layer of moisture before serums or makeup.

listings.rawTitle: The Method: Polish Face Peeling 120 ml
listings.description: Pure minerals, plant enzymes and a warming element make this polish a gentle skin resurfacing treatment. Your natural cell turnover is boosted and underlying cells are signaled to help produce fresher, younger-looking skin.Natural quartz and sodium bicarbonate crystals, used for the uniformity of their size and shape, provide precise exfoliation without the risk of micro-cuts or abrasion. Pumpkin and pomegranate extracts break down peptide bonds in surface cells so they can be more easily sloughed off. Brown sea algae moisturizes and help stimulate collagen protection.

listings.rawTitle: Enchanted Island Salt Spray Hair Spray 124 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the lush Galapagos Islands, Rahua's Enchanted Island™ Salt Spray captures the spirit of a beach jaunt and one of its many perks - perfectly tousled, wavy beach hair!By incorporating natural pink sea salt for texture and the exotic scent cocktail of guayaba, hibiscus and passion fruit, locks are left with tropically perfumed, lustrous, defined waves.

listings.rawTitle: The Method: Nourish Face Cream 50 ml
listings.description: This potent anti-aging treatment helps skin retain moisture and boosts its oxygen level while aiding cell function and metabolism. Your skin is left nourished for a visibly renewed and youthful glow. Nourish delivers a maximum payload of anti-aging ingredients to the skin after skin is properly cleansed and exfoliated, so it's as receptive to your skincare as possible.

listings.rawTitle: Coconut Hand Wash Hand soap & scrub 295 ml
listings.description: This refreshing hand wash combines excellent cleansing with skin-conditioning ingredients to leave hands feeling soft and healthy, wash after wash. The moisture-replenishing formula blends soothing pro-vitamin B5 with aloe vera to create an exceptional cleanser made especially for the hands. Fragranced with a sensual blend of toasted coconut and creamy coconut milk.

listings.rawTitle: Rose Salve Lip Balm 22 g

listings.rawTitle: Next Generation Eye Base Eye Pencil 2 g
listings.description: A gliding, creamy crayon infused with Rose Stem Cell and Grape Extract to soothe and smooth the eyelids. As a base, it enhances the wear of all eye shadow types. A soft-focus blurring effect adds instant polish when worn on its own.

listings.rawTitle: Mind Energy Eau de Parfum Unisex 50 ml
listings.description: MIND ENERGY uses patented olfactory technology to stimulate neural pathways helping invigorate and energize your mental energy. A sensory supplement with clary sage, juniper, pink peppercorn and clove – it is peppery and fresh with a warm, velvety base.

listings.rawTitle: Skin Hero Tinted day cream 15 ml
listings.description: SKIN HERO has a transparent, silicone-free and nourishing formula that visibly optimizes skin texture day after day. It combines the effectiveness of Korean White Ginseng with enzymes, leaving a "New Skin" effect in just 7 days. At the same time, it reduces redness, evens skin texture and visually evens out the complexion. As a final step in the routine, the light cream provides natural protection against external influences and environmental pollution.

listings.rawTitle: SUPER BB CLAIR BB Cream 15 ml
listings.description: This super BB cream is half skincare, half makeup. De formula effectively conceals imperfections and visually evens out the complexion without being too opaque. For a natural and flawless skin. The cream is enriched with White Ginseng and fermented Ginseng flowers, which immediately moisturize and provide a visibly smoother complexion. Contained niacinamide reduces imperfections and refines the appearance of pores.

listings.rawTitle: SUPER BB NUDE BB Cream 40 ml
listings.description: This super BB cream is half skincare, half makeup. De formula effectively conceals imperfections and visually evens out the complexion without being too opaque. For a natural and flawless skin. The cream is enriched with White Ginseng and fermented Ginseng flowers, which immediately moisturize and provide a visibly smoother complexion. Contained niacinamide reduces imperfections and refines the appearance of pores.

listings.rawTitle: PHAZE Cleansing Gel 28 ml
listings.description: This gentle foam face wash is formulated with a dream team of kind-to-skin actives that work in perfect harmony. Exfoliating PHA (Polyhydroxy Acid) unclogs pores and removes impurities, to help keep skin clear. Prebiotic Inulin rebalances the skin's microbiome and strengthens the barrier. And finally, NMF (Natural Moisturising Factor) Sugar Complex binds to your skin's keratin for long-lasting hydration. A new Phaze in skincare, and a face wash revolution.

listings.rawTitle: The Radiance Face Peeling 80 ml
listings.description: A gentle exfoliating cream with an added enzyme complex and super fine crystals which create a microdermabrasion action that polishes and removes dead skin cells and impurities for a healthier looking glow.

listings.rawTitle: Istros Aromatique Room Spray 100 ml
listings.description: A union of enlivening florals and Tobacco, Istros stimulates the atmosphere with aromas of the bazaar.Istros is a scent of what has been left behind: a street baked by heat during the day, cooled at night; tendrils of tobacco smoke long dispersed; bazaars that bear the etchings of commerce, commotion and carnival. But more than this, it is a communion with the creative spirits who have journeyed through—an energy distilled from their traces.Notes: Pink Pepper, Lavender, Tobacco

listings.rawTitle: Olous Aromatique Room Spray 100 ml
listings.description: A blend of citrus botanicals, balanced by breaking waves of Cedar and the refreshing spice of Cardamom. Just as words are born of our breath, Olous rouses an exhalation of clipped, green aroma. Boundless as it is, nature makes its presence felt inside the home—stillness ensues. The environment is redefined to an elemental time, when life was all silence—pleasantly devoid of the babble of phone chatter, or the burring hum of the mechanical.Notes: Galbanum, Grapefruit, Jasmine

listings.rawTitle: Restoring Moonseed Treatment Night Cream 50 ml
listings.description: An innovative repair treatment transforms from a solid balm into a decadent oil for overnight rejuvenation. A blend of over 30 repairing Ayurvedic ingredients with powerful antioxidants and adaptogens helps to reduce the appearance of fine lines, calms redness and irritation, and strengthens the skin barrier for skin that is smooth, deeply hydrated, and even toned by morning.

listings.rawTitle: VLITTER Natural Face & Body Glow Highlighter 30 ml
listings.description: VLITTER Natural Face & Body Glow with a nourishing formula thanks to aloe vera and magnolia extract. Whether pure or as a multi-use drop-in - with the liquid highlighter VLITTER every skin shines with a natural glow. VLITTER is Middle High German for whisper, giggle, caress. Available shades:COOL MOON 01 – A fresh, almost glassy rose tone with an iridescent shimmer. Reminiscent of a cool summer night.WARM SUN 02 – A warm gold tone with an iridescent shimmer. Reminiscent of a hot summer day.

listings.rawTitle: Orchidée Vanille Eau de Parfum Women 75 ml
listings.description: This Orchidee Vanille Eau de Parfum by Van Cleef & Arpels is a floral fragrance. It opens with top notes of orange, lychee, dark chocolate, and bitter almond before settling into a floral heart of Bulgarian rose and violet. The base notes of cedar wood, white musk, and tonka bean leave a lasting memory.

listings.rawTitle: Bois Doré Eau de Parfum Unisex 75 ml
listings.description: This Bois Dore Eau de Parfum by Van Cleef & Arpels features top notes of spicy black pepper and various minerals fused with a heart of nutty almond, cedarwood, and tobacco. Base notes of tonka bean, teakwood and a touch of white musk ends the perfume for a tantalizing elixir.

listings.rawTitle: Neroli Amara Eau de Parfum Unisex 75 ml
listings.description: At the beginning, Néroli Amara seems to exude the invigorating freshness and impression of a cologne on the skin. A radiant accord of sun-kissed citrus aromas enters into an invigorating, subtly spicy dialogue with pink pepper and noble cypress wood. Top and heart notes blend harmoniously and then reveal the true character as well as the infinitely multifaceted floral opulence of the creation. For the finale, the eau de parfum reveals the wonderful vision of its creator come true. The sensual scent of orange blossom - warm, sweet and intoxicating - embraces and seduces the senses like a gentle breeze, reminiscent of the warmth and delight of the Mediterranean spring sun.

listings.rawTitle: Santal Blanc Eau de Parfum Women 75 ml
listings.description: The multi-faceted fragrance brings the delicate facets of sandalwood to full fruition to exude a uniquely pure, white materiality. White as purity. White like softness. White like the perfect balance. That is why the iconic bottle of the "Collection Extraordinaire" is presented for the first time in immaculate white to reflect the perfection of the olfactory structure. The fragrance is a composition with tangy mandarin, sandalwood and fig milk. A hint of musk, plus powdery violet and deliciously almondy tonka bean characterize Santal Blanc's velvety-soft, sensory-enveloping finish.

listings.rawTitle: Oud Blanc Eau de Parfum Unisex 75 ml
listings.description: This Oud Blanc Eau de Parfum by Van Cleef & Arpels is a woody fragrance for women and men. It features the scent of burning wood, opening with a date accord and leading to an intoxicating heart of incense and oud accord. White musks and vanilla bean leave a lingering trail that’s warm and addictive.

listings.rawTitle: Bois d'Amande Eau de Parfum Unisex 75 ml
listings.description: This Bois D'Amande Eau de Parfum by Van Cleef & Arpels is a Oriental Woody fragrance. Top notes of lemon and almond entice the senses, while cedarwood, amber and vanilla shine through from the base.

listings.rawTitle: Essential Eye Fix Eye Serum 10 ml
listings.description: De-puff, firm and rehydrate the delicate eye area with this highly targeted serum. The formula targets both the root cause and physical signs of stress-induced aging. Essential Eye Fix opens, refreshes and really brightens the eyes giving the appearance of a perfect night sleep!” - Annee de Mamiel, Founder.Chronic stress can show on your face. The hormone that your body releases when you feel stress, Cortisol, causes changes to the proteins in your skin which reduce its elasticity. This loss of elasticity can contribute to wrinkle formation and is compounded by stress impacting the skin’s ability to retain water, it impairs the stratum corneum’s barrier function leading to dehydration. The delicate eye area is particularly susceptible and additionally can be prone to under eye bags, characterized by swelling or puffiness beneath your eyelids. These become exacerbated with age as the supporting muscles around the eyes weaken. Sleep deprivation further increases all signs of aging, fine lines, reduced elasticity, and uneven pigmentation.

listings.rawTitle: DAY Day Cream 50 ml
listings.description: Radiant and beautiful skin every day: DAY by DOCTOR MI! medical skincare is your perfect companion on your way to achieving this. As an anti-aging day cream, DAY contains some luxurious active ingredient complexes that reliably protect your skin from external influences during the day as well as strengthening it and making it glow from the inside out.The special anti-aging effect in DAY primarily stems from the unique TECMi!® retinol: Retinol is known as a powerful ingredient with anti-aging effects. The TECMi!® retinol in DAY, however, is an even more effective form of retinol. Thanks to the TECMi!® Technology, in which retinol molecules are encapsulated twice, it can penetrate directly into the lower layers of your skin without any problems. This makes it possible for DOCTOR Mi! medical skincare to ensure that no retinol adheres to your skin surface which would irritate and weaken it, but rather that the retinol molecules immediately arrive where they need to and are able to unfold their full anti-aging effect. Because of this unique form of molecule preparation, our retinol day cream DAY supports you throughout your day in your transition to a healthy, fresh and renewed complexion without irritating your skin. The TECMi!® retinol content is dosed in such a way that using it during the day, even in the summer time, is no problem at all.Besides TECMi!® retinol, DAY also contains a whole range of other evidence-based, nourishing substances that protect your skin and stimulate cell regeneration. The high proportion of antioxidants, for example, ensures cell renewal and strengthens your skin barrier. Oligo-hyaluronic acid and acetylglucosamine reactivate your skin and foster the body's own production of hyaluronic acid which usually decreases with age and results in wrinkles. DAY also contains ectoin which protects your skin from UV radiation and dryness as well as vitamin B3 (niacinamide) to promote your skin's collagen production, to regulate sebum production and to also make your skin smooth and soft.

listings.rawTitle: NIGHT Night Cream 50ml
listings.description: NIGHT, the anti-aging night cream with retinol by DOCTOR MI! gives your skin a rest at nights: While you are sleeping, selected active ingredients penetrate deep into your skin and renew it from the inside. The double-encapsulated TECMi!® retinol being the most significant in NIGHT: Retinol, also known as vitamin A1, is a scientifically proven active ingredient for skin rejuvination. It is crucial that retinol does not adhere to the surface of the skin as it can cause skin irritation. Thanks to the unique molecule preparation with our TECMi!® Technology, the retinol contained in NIGHT is able to penetrate directly into the dermis, the lower layer of the skin, and activate the skin cells located there to foster skin regeneration without any skin irritation.Besides the high-dose TECMi!® retinol, the anti-aging night cream NIGHT also contains a number of other, highly functional active ingredients: The probiotic ProRenew COMPLEX CLR™, an evidence-based active ingredient that protects your skin barrier, accelerates skin regeneration, manifests fresh and soft skin and is even beneficial for problem and very sensitive skin. Vitamin B3 restores the balance of your skin thanks to its anti-inflammatory properties while the antioxidant complex DEFENSIL® PLUS stabilizes its pH value and further strengthens your skin barrier. Moreover, SyriCalm® CLR accelerates wound healing and is a helpful active ingredient in treating pigment disorders. Enriched with these highly effective and evidence-based ingredients, our anti-aging night cream NIGHT enables your skin to have a restful night and a radiant morning.

listings.rawTitle: TONE.S Toner 150 ml
listings.description: First aid for blemished and oily skin: TONE.S is a toner with salicylic acid that effectively clears and balances blemished and oily skin. Thanks to its increased salicylic acid content, TONE.S removes impurities very effectively, has an anti-inflammatory effect and evens out the skin barrier.As a toner with BHA, TONE.S contains beta-hydroxy acid (known as salicylic acid), which has been proven to help with acne and increased sebum production: Unlike AHA acid which are also contained but are soley water soluble, salicylic acid has the abilitly to dissolve oils. BHA toners are, therefore, particularly effective on oily and blemished skin.The salicylic acid's effect in the toner is reinforced by the special TECMi!® encapsulation: The double-encapsulated BHA molecules are particularly gentle on the skin and, thus, can penetrate the lower skin layer, or dermis, more easily. Once there, they can unleash their full potential by cleansing and calming your skin as well as effectively regulate sebum production. Addtionally, the BHA increases the ability of your skin to bind water, to prevent the formation of impurities, and to visibly clarify and refine your skin. Besides the high dosage of BHA and AHA acids, TONE.S also consists of a highly dosed lactate buffers which have a particularly hydrating effect on your skin, promote its moisture retention and stabilize its pH value. The essential amino acids in TONE.S, including gluconic, tartaric and malic acid, provide important vital substances, rejuvenate your skin from the inside out and effectively prevent skin aging. listings.rawTitle: Menopause Formula Powder 180 g
listings.description: The Menopause Formula by Equi London is a powdered supplement containing 48 premium, bio-available nutrients specifically selected for their synergistic ability to assist and boost the female body at a time when it is most in need of balance. Commonly experienced peri-men/menopausal symptoms include hormonal fluctuations, depleted energy, hot flushes, low mood, a foggy head, poor sleep sagging skin, metabolic changes (including potential weight gain), dryness and a low libido. The formula provides soothing support to help women overcome these fluctuations, whilst also aiding bone density, joint health and the cardiovascular system, are of which are necessary for holistic health.

listings.rawTitle: Gravity Fix Brightening serum 30 ml
listings.description: An all-natural combination of green biotech, plant actives and extracts, Gravity Fix includes Glycoin, a natural stress protection molecule which helps reactivate cell energy as it smooths and redensifies. Goji Berry stimulates collagen production and biofermented Retinal, a precursor to retinoic acid, encourages cell turnover, plumps and promotes elasticity which is so needed in slackened skin. Red algae conditions and protects telomeres to help retard skin ageing, Ceramides strengthen the protective skin barrier while White Truffle brightens and Acetyl Glycosamine encourages the production of Hyaluronic Acid to improve hydration and suppleness. Formulated using de Mamiel’s East meets West clean clinical approach, Gravity Fix harnesses the power of aromatherapy to actively reduce the impact of stress, instil a sense of grounding calm and gently restore skin to its glowing, hydrated and balanced best. “For some, stress affects the skin through the glycation pathway causing degradation of collagen and elastin and, over time, loss of tone and firmness in the skin. Gravity Fix specifically targets this pathway, helping to rebuild and firm the skin.” – Annee de Mamiel, Founder.
